label: CKPT_SAMPLER_INCONSISTENT
fix_claim: Restore the sampler position from the committed checkpoint alongside the model and optimizer. The previous attempt's progress had advanced beyond that checkpoint, causing resumed training to skip samples.
patch:
diff --git a/job/ckpt.py b/job/ckpt.py
--- a/job/ckpt.py
+++ b/job/ckpt.py
@@ -60,5 +60,5 @@
     sd["state"] = {int(k[4:]): {"momentum_buffer": v.clone()} for k, v in state.items() if k.startswith("opt.")}
     opt.load_state_dict(sd)
     if "sampler" in state:  # checkpoints from before the sampler was tracked have no position
-        sampler.load_state(_progress(rank, state["sampler"]))
+        sampler.load_state(state["sampler"])
     return int(state["step"])
